Jan Suraj Leader Shot Five Times in Patna

Anil Yadav, a leader associated with Jan Suraj, was shot multiple times in Patna's Buddha Colony area. Police reported he sustained 4-5 bullet wounds and is undergoing treatment at a hospital. Jan Suraj founder Prashant Kishor visited the hospital after learning of the incident. The attackers were reportedly on a motorcycle.
